svg.aria-label: Five different tiger cubs in a row, each sitting on its own Jetson AGX Thor developer kit. Volt, on thor-1, the front door, is grey-blue with a winged helmet and a raised hammer. Ember, on thor-2, a second model, is a lean orange cub with fierce eyes, a flame for a tail and both paws in the air. Frost, on thor-3, a third model, is a round white cub with sleepy eyes, a knitted hat and a scarf, holding an ice crystal. Leaf, on thor-4, training, is a small green cub with leaves for ears and closed, smiling eyes, waving. Nova, on thor-5, batch work, is a violet cub with tall ears, a wizard's hat and a star wand. A cable at 25 gigabits a second runs from each Thor down to one 25 GbE switch.
svg.text: Five Thors on one switch, and a job for each.
ONE SHELF · FIVE JETSON AGX THOR
25 GbE switch · every Thor reaches every other Thor through it
Five Thors, each with a cub of its own and a job of its own. One cable from each leads to the switch.
Volt keeps the front door, Ember and Frost serve models, Leaf trains, and Nova runs the batch work.
